item.title: Ask HN: Combining Healthcare and Software Engineering into a Career
item.summary: I'm a former software engineer (self-taught) who is currently in school studying Kinesiology. I plan on going to graduate school for Occupational Therapy or Physical Therapy. Before starting school, I gained a few years of experience working with disabled children. I decided to pursue OT/PT because I very much enjoy working with disabled populations, but want more autonomy to actually make decisions that impact their well being. Despite all of this (and a rocky resume), I still feel like programming is a part of me and is something I find enjoyable as a discipline. Has anyone successfully made a career combining healthcare and software engineering? How did you do it? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49390762 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
